title: BetterInvest
description: A fully featured Minecraft investment and company tycoon plugin where players can create businesses, invest in others through a stock-market style GUI, and earn passive income through a share-based economy system. Designed for Paper 1.21.x
body:
**BetterInvest** (Company Investment Tycoon Plugin) is a fully custom economy and investment system for Paper 1.21.x servers. Players can create companies, manage assets, and allow others to invest through a modern GUI-based stock market style system.

Requires Vault or EssentialsX for economy support. Creating a company costs $100,000.

Each company grows in value over time through player investments and deposited resources, generating passive income that is shared between investors and the owner. Investors earn dividends based on their share percentage, while company owners receive additional bonus payouts for successful growth.

The plugin includes a full company management system with levels, leaderboards, company health ratings, decay mechanics, bankruptcy systems, and advanced statistics. Everything is designed around a polished GUI experience, making investing simple, interactive, and competitive.

Built for performance and scalability, BetterInvest supports Vault, EssentialsX, PlaceholderAPI, and both SQLite and MySQL, making it suitable for small servers or large SMP networks.

Create your empire, invest wisely, and dominate the economy.
